Saudi Arabia Faces Air Travel Safety Warnings After Attacks

The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has issued a warning to American airlines regarding safety risks associated with flying over Saudi Arabia, following recent attacks. The attacks have raised concerns about the kingdom's aviation security and its broader ambitions.
